_note: Optional. Copy to atlas.config.json (gitignored). Every field has a default and most have an environment-variable override — see src/config.ts. `field` is what the Field offers: the defaults shown are the one-view setup (the tour through meaning + time, time fixed left to right); add "blobs" / "plane" to modes or "m4" / "ar" to spaces to get the other presentations back.
contact: https://github.com/you/your-fork — or an email; this goes in the crawler's User-Agent so a site you crawl can reach you
own_origin: https://example.com/blyg/   — your own blyg, if you publish one; your items stay out of pulse and standing queries
publisher: ../my-blyg/publish.ts   — a script offering `reply <ref> <text> [--quote …] [--dry-run | --yes --no-mention]` and `mention <id> --wait`; enables casual replies from the dashboard
embedder: auto   — how nomic-embed-text runs: "ollama", "local" (in this process, no Ollama needed), or "auto" (Ollama when it is running, in-process otherwise). Both give the same vectors.
